summary: 2 hackathon wins and an international selection, from 3 entries

hackathons.project: Polkaflow -visual blockchain workflow builder for Polkadot
hackathons.oneLiner: Drag-and-drop flowchart to deployed smart contract, with AI code-gen, a hand-built logic engine, and automatic Solidity-to-Rust optimization for gas-heavy functions.
hackathons.myRole: NEEDS_INPUT: team size + your specific contribution -the repo (github.com/sogalabhi/Polkadot) is on your account, which suggests you led or built the core, but confirm what part was yours if it was a team effort

hackathons.project: Polar Bridge -cross-chain lending, INR collateral to PAS tokens
hackathons.oneLiner: A fiat-to-Polkadot on-ramp -pay by UPI, borrow PAS tokens against INR collateral, no crypto knowledge needed.
hackathons.myRole: Web3 developer, 2-person team -built the smart contracts and the relayer service handling cross-chain event synchronization between the Stellar vault and the Paseo Asset Hub pool

hackathons.result: Selected for the offline round in Delhi -international event
hackathons.project: PokeWars -multiplayer Pokémon shooting game with Web3 rewards on Polygon
hackathons.oneLiner: Wallet-authenticated multiplayer combat in Phaser, with NFT-owned Pokémon and daily on-chain rewards via the X402 protocol.
hackathons.myRole: NEEDS_INPUT: your specific contribution -repo is under teammate Kushagra1122's account, so this needs to be precise rather than "we built." Which parts were yours -the Phaser combat loop, the WebSocket sync layer, something else?

note_to_self: Three entries, no filler tier -dropped the plan to list non-placing hackathons as compact rows. If more hackathons come up later with a real result worth showing, add them in the same full-entry shape as these three, not as a lesser tier.
